div.div: Through the phone the first response byte costs about 5x (Wi-Fi) to 10x (cellular) [calc] the direct path, because every round trip after CONNECT travels cloud -> phone -> site and back (illustrative model)
Time to first response byte, server time excluded. Bar length to scale: 1.25 px per ms. Segment labels give the cost of each step.

direct from the cloud (no phone)
total 60 ms [I5]
TCP 20 + TLS 1.3 20 + HTTP 20 (each one RTTcs: the cloud talks to the site directly)

via phone, Wi-Fi, pipelined (not used by the source)
total 270 ms [I5]

via phone, cellular, pipelined (not used by the source)
total 480 ms [I5]

INPUTS (all illustrative round values)
RTTcp cloud<->phone: Wi-Fi 50 ms, cellular 120 ms [I1]
RTTps phone<->site: 30 ms [I2]
DNS on the phone: 30 ms [I4]
RTTcs cloud<->site: 20 ms [I3]

READING IT
- The two SOCKS5 exchanges add RTTcp each; DNS moves to the phone.
- Direct = TCP + TLS 1.3 handshakes (2 round trips [P6]) + one HTTP exchange.
- Pipelining: the phone always picks 'no auth', so the listener could send method request and CONNECT together and save one RTTcp (dashed bars; an idea the source does not use).

Legend: amber = SOCKS5 method exchange | green = CONNECT (includes phone DNS and the phone's TCP connect) | blue = TLS 1.3 handshake | white = HTTP exchange | grey = direct TCP | dashed = pipelined variant.

Sources. Every number is loaded from ../constants.json by the key shown. [Pn] = public (an RFC or other public document, or my arithmetic on one); [In] = illustrative (a design parameter or a round value of the right order; never a measurement of a real deployment); [calc] = my arithmetic on tagged values.
Mechanism: notes/A1-the-end-to-end-picture.md (latency model table, pipelining idea); notes/B2-quic-for-this-job.md (handshake round trips). [calc]: segment costs from the inputs; each row sum is asserted equal to ttfb_model_illustrative; ratios 320 / 60 = 5.3 and 600 / 60 = 10.0. The kit's latency targets (latency_target_illustrative) are not drawn: the illustrative Wi-Fi p50 target sits below this modelled floor, so the two illustrative values do not agree.
[I1] rtt_cloud_phone_illustrative = {wifi: 50, cellular: 120} ms. illustrative: round round-trip times between a cloud region and a phone
[I2] rtt_phone_site_illustrative = 30 ms. illustrative: round RTT from the phone's network to a nearby site
[I3] rtt_cloud_site_illustrative = 20 ms. illustrative: round RTT from a cloud region to a site
[I4] phone_dns_typical_illustrative = 30 ms. illustrative: round resolver time on the phone
[I5] ttfb_model_illustrative = {wifi: 320, cellular: 600, wifi_pipelined: 270, cellular_pipelined: 480, direct_from_cloud: 60} ms to first response byte (server time excluded). illustrative: my arithmetic in A1 from the rtt_* and phone_dns_typical_illustrative values: method 1 x RTTcp + CONNECT (RTTcp + DNS + RTTps) + TLS 1.3 (RTTcp + RTTps) + HTTP (RTTcp + RTTps); pipelined removes one RTTcp; direct = 3 x RTTcs
[P6] quic_handshake_round_trips = {quic_tls13_new: 1, quic_0rtt_resumed: 0, tcp_plus_tls13: 2, tcp_plus_tls12: 3} round trips before application data. public: RFC 9000 §7 and RFC 9001 §4; RFC 8446 §2 (TLS 1.3 1-RTT); TCP three-way handshake (RFC 9293) adds one; my arithmetic for the sums
